scriptBlueprint.hookArchetype: Nghịch lý hiện vật dị thường làm sụp đổ lịch sử chính thống (Paradoxical Artifact Discovery Hook)
scriptBlueprint.openingFormula: In 1986, two workers digging a routine drainage ditch in Sichuan Province struck something metallic. When they pulled it from the mud, they found a bronze face over a meter wide with eyes protruding on 10cm stalks — an artifact so advanced it rivaled ancient Egypt, yet 3,000 years of recorded Chinese history never mentioned this civilization once...
scriptBlueprint.pacingStructure: [0–15s] Hook phát hiện hiện vật dị thường trong bùn đất -> [15–45s] Nghịch lý: Tại sao một nền văn minh đúc đồng vĩ đại bị xóa sổ hoàn toàn khỏi sử sách? -> [45s–30m] 3 hồ sơ khảo cổ chấn động (Tam Tinh Đôi Tứ Xuyên, Đền Göbekli Tepe 12.000 năm tuổi trước cả nông nghiệp, Đô thị ngầm Amazon) với mini-cliffhanger mỗi 90s -> [Kết thúc] Đúc kết: Nhân loại không phải là nền văn minh đầu tiên
scriptBlueprint.masterScriptPromptShort: Prompt chuẩn 70% dữ liệu khảo cổ gốc + 30% phản biện mới, chia 10–15 Part (1000–1100 từ/Part), điều khiển bằng lệnh 'CONTINUE' và dừng bằng 'Stop' theo chuẩn North Effect.
scriptBlueprint.masterScriptPrompt:
You are a professional scriptwriter specializing in strategic historical documentaries and forbidden archaeology (style of Hidden Planet Docs, Graham Hancock, and Joe Rogan Archaeology).

I will provide you with [the full original transcript from a competitor’s video].
Your task:

1. Rewrite & Restructure:
   - Keep 70% of the original script to preserve the storyline, factual accuracy, and core artifact evidence.
   - Add 30% new content: creative expansion, geological/historical context, expert commentary, or contrasting academic hypotheses using archaeological research.
   - Writing style: Documentary Archival Realism — serious, mysterious, atmospheric, analytical, and deeply engaging.

2. Technical Requirements:
   - Total length depends on the original video script provided.
   - Divide the script into 10–15 parts (depending on video length).
   - Each part should be 1000–1100 words, written in continuous narrative (no subheadings inside, ready for voiceover).
   - Title each part as: Part n (n = sequence number).

3. Workflow Instructions:
   - For every command "CONTINUE" from me:
     - You must expand only the next part according to the sequence.
     - Do not skip ahead.
   - At the end of each part, write "Stop" so I can issue the "CONTINUE" command.
   - After the final part is completed, you must add "Script Completed" at the very end.

---
📌 How to Use:
- Step 1: I will paste the competitor’s full script after this prompt.
- Step 2: You will start rewriting Part 1 (1000–1100 words) according to the rules above.
- Step 3: I will type "CONTINUE" to move forward part by part until the entire script is finished.
